name: Infoblox — BloxOne Threat Protect DROP (Post-Connection C2 Detection)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "Threat"
| filter infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log contains "threat-protect-log"
| alter src_ip = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "src=(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
        category = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "cat=\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
| filter src_ip != null
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as drops,
       count_distinct(category) as distinct_categories,
       values(category) as categories
       by src_ip, _time
| filter drops >= 1
| fields src_ip, categories
description: Infoblox xdm.event.type = 'Threat' with threat-protect-log marker — BloxOne Threat-Protect dropped a C2 / malware-category connection from the compromised device.
alert_name: Infoblox — BloxOne Threat Protect DROP (Post-Connection C2 Detection)
